title: relay land closes a feature after its first change
what: A feature built in several changes stays open until its last change lands: the cycle unit or `relay land` says whether this landing finishes the item (for example `relay land --keep-open` or a unit field), and the default stays closing it as today.
why: Found by the front 30 Oct: the VPS feature build-time-gates-on-the-vps-landing-gate-on-the is built in 4 changes (design rev 2, section 7); when change 2 landed, `relay land wt/build-time-gates-on-the-vps-landing-gate` printed 'closed build-time-gates-on-the-vps-landing-gate-on-the (feature, ip 90), landed on master at ea468ce7': lib/relay_land.py _close_features closes the feature item of any landed branch, so changes 3-5 lost their item and the front re-queued them by hand as a new item.
failing_case: A feature item taken by branch B; land B as an intermediate change: the item is closed on master.
pass_cases: an intermediate landing leaves the feature open and taken
the last landing closes it as today

question: After an intermediate landing of a multi-change feature (relay land --keep-open), does the feature stay taken by the deleted branch, or go back to open for the next change? (review F4)
options: a. released: open, not taken, with a dated fact of the landed sha; relay queue start starts the next change at once
b. stays taken by the deleted branch; the next change needs relay queue release first, or start learns to accept it
because: principles 10 and 3: the next change starts with one command, and a take by a branch that no longer exists is state that contradicts git; "open and taken" in the pass case was the front's wording, not the owner's
